external_source_events_reference_consist.name: external_source_events_reference_consistency
external_source_events_reference_consist.value:
(
      ("external_source_events"."event_type" = 'settlement_credit' and "external_source_events"."internal_refund_id" is null)
      or ("external_source_events"."event_type" = 'refund_debit' and "external_source_events"."internal_payment_id" is null and "external_source_events"."provider_payment_reference" is null)
    )

ledger_entries_source_effect_consistent.name: ledger_entries_source_effect_consistent
ledger_entries_source_effect_consistent.value:
(
        ("ledger_entries"."effect_type" = 'payment_recorded' and "ledger_entries"."payment_id" is not null and "ledger_entries"."refund_id" is null)
        or ("ledger_entries"."effect_type" = 'refund_recorded' and "ledger_entries"."payment_id" is null and "ledger_entries"."refund_id" is not null)
      )

reconciliation_actions_transition_allowe.name: reconciliation_actions_transition_allowed
reconciliation_actions_transition_allowe.value:
(
      ("reconciliation_actions"."action_type" = 'acknowledge' and "reconciliation_actions"."from_status" = 'open' and "reconciliation_actions"."to_status" = 'acknowledged')
      or ("reconciliation_actions"."action_type" = 'resolve' and "reconciliation_actions"."from_status" in ('open', 'acknowledged') and "reconciliation_actions"."to_status" = 'resolved')
      or ("reconciliation_actions"."action_type" = 'ignore' and "reconciliation_actions"."from_status" in ('open', 'acknowledged') and "reconciliation_actions"."to_status" = 'ignored')
    )

reconciliation_findings_rule_semantics.name: reconciliation_findings_rule_semantics
reconciliation_findings_rule_semantics.value:
(
      ("reconciliation_findings"."rule_code" = 'STRIPE_SUCCESS_MISSING_INTERNAL_PAYMENT' and "reconciliation_findings"."severity" = 'critical' and "reconciliation_findings"."subject_type" = 'stripe_webhook_event')
      or ("reconciliation_findings"."rule_code" = 'INTERNAL_PAYMENT_MISSING_BANK_SETTLEMENT' and "reconciliation_findings"."severity" = 'warning' and "reconciliation_findings"."subject_type" = 'payment')
      or ("reconciliation_findings"."rule_code" = 'BANK_SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT_MISMATCH' and "reconciliation_findings"."severity" = 'critical' and "reconciliation_findings"."subject_type" = 'payment')
      or ("reconciliation_findings"."rule_code" = 'INTERNAL_REFUND_MISSING_BANK_OUTFLOW' and "reconciliation_findings"."severity" = 'warning' and "reconciliation_findings"."subject_type" = 'refund')
      or ("reconciliation_findings"."rule_code" = 'ORPHAN_BANK_MOVEMENT' and "reconciliation_findings"."severity" = 'warning' and "reconciliation_findings"."subject_type" = 'external_source_event')
    )

stripe_webhook_events_state_consistency.name: stripe_webhook_events_state_consistency
stripe_webhook_events_state_consistency.value:
(
        ("stripe_webhook_events"."status" = 'received' and "stripe_webhook_events"."processing_token" is null and "stripe_webhook_events"."processing_started_at" is null and "stripe_webhook_events"."payment_id" is null and "stripe_webhook_events"."processed_at" is null and "stripe_webhook_events"."last_error_code" is null)
        or ("stripe_webhook_events"."status" = 'processing' and "stripe_webhook_events"."processing_token" is not null and "stripe_webhook_events"."processing_started_at" is not null and "stripe_webhook_events"."payment_id" is null and "stripe_webhook_events"."processed_at" is null and "stripe_webhook_events"."last_error_code" is null)
        or ("stripe_webhook_events"."status" = 'processed' and "stripe_webhook_events"."processing_token" is null and "stripe_webhook_events"."processing_started_at" is null and "stripe_webhook_events"."payment_id" is not null and "stripe_webhook_events"."processed_at" is not null and "stripe_webhook_events"."last_error_code" is null and "stripe_webhook_events"."stripe_payment_intent_id" is not null)
        or ("stripe_webhook_events"."status" = 'failed' and "stripe_webhook_events"."processing_token" is null and "stripe_webhook_events"."processing_started_at" is null and "stripe_webhook_events"."payment_id" is null and "stripe_webhook_events"."processed_at" is not null and "stripe_webhook_events"."last_error_code" is not null)
      )
